title: UNIT FOUR: POLITICS, ECONOMY AND SOCIETY FROM THE LATE THIRTEENTH TO THE BEGINNING OF THE SIXTEENTH CENTURIES
content:
ሰላም ሰላም ውድና የምንወዳችሁ የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦቻችን! 🤗❤️✨ ተናፍቃችኋል! ዛሬ ደግሞ በታላቅ ጉጉትና ፍቅር ወደጠበቃችሁት የHistory of Ethiopia and the Horn (Hist. 1012) Unit 4 Part 2 Tutorial በደስታ ተመልሰናል። ዛሬ በክፍል ሁለት ትምህርታችን፦ የጥንቷ ኢትዮጵያ ንጉሠ ነገሥታት ግዛታቸውን እንዴት ያስተዳድሩና ጦራቸውን እንዴት ያደራጁ እንደነበር (3 concentric circles model እና የጨዋ ጦር)፣ የመንግሥቱ የኢኮኖሚ መሠረቶች፣ እንዲሁም በክርስቲያንና ሙስሊም ሱልጣኔቶች መካከል የነበረውን የንግድና የበላይነት ሽኩቻ ከ4.4 እስከ 4.7.1 በዝርዝር፣ በምሳሌዎችና ለፈተና በሚጠቅሙ አጫጭር ነጥቦች (Exam Hints) አዘጋጅተንላችኋል። ቡናችሁን/ሻያችሁን ይዛችሁ አብራችሁን እስከ መጨረሻው ቆዩ! ☕📖🚀

4.4. Administration and Military Organization of the Ethiopian Christian Kingdom

4.4.1. Administration

• Nature of the Realm: Amde-Tsion's vast kingdom was not a unified state, but a loose confederation of numerous principalities with diverse religious, ethnic, and linguistic traits. Monarchs used military campaigns to attempt forming a cohesive administrative machinery.
• Three Concentric Circles Model:
1. Innermost Circle: Core provinces directly controlled by the emperor and administered by his representatives where centralized administration was strongest.
2. Second Circle: Autonomous territories whose rulers retained hereditary positions upon submission, paying tribute, and fulfilling obligations. Heavily garrisoned by the chewa military regiments to ensure loyalty.
3. Third Circle: Outer territories beyond direct control where authority was symbolic. Local rulers were expected to pay tribute; failure to do so resulted in military raids.
• Centralization Attempts: Emperor Zara-Yaqob (r. 1434–1468) attempted radical centralization by creating state officials, strengthening central authority, and involving the church hierarchy. However, his radical approach backfired, uniting rival factions against his reforms.

👉
1. የአስተዳደር መዋቅር (Three Concentric Circles): የዓምደ-ጽዮን መንግሥት አንድ ወጥ ሳይሆን የበርካታ ህዝቦችና ግዛቶች ስብስብ ነበር። አስተዳደሩ በ3 ከበቦች የተዋቀረ ነው፦
- የውስጠኛው ከበብ (Core): በንጉሡ በቀጥታና በወኪሎቹ የሚተዳደሩ ማዕከላዊ ግዛቶች።
- ሁለተኛው ከበብ: ግብር የሚከፍሉ፣ የራሳቸውን መሪዎች የሚያስተዳድሩ ነገር ግን በጨዋ (Chewa) ጦር የሚጠበቁ ግዛቶች።
- ሦስተኛው (የውጪው) ከበብ: የንጉሡ ሥልጣን በስም ብቻ የሚታወቅባቸው፣ ግብር ካልከፈሉ ግን ዘመቻ የሚከፈትባቸው ራቅ ያሉ ቦታዎች።
2. የአፄ ዘርዐ ያዕቆብ የማዕከላዊነት ጥረት: አፄ ዘርዐ ያዕቆብ (1434-1468) ቤተክርስቲያንንና አዳዲስ ሹመኞችን በመጠቀም ጠንካራ ማዕከላዊ አስተዳደር ለመመሥረት ቢሞክሩም ጥረታቸው ተቃዋሚዎችን አንድ ለማድረግ አልተሳካም።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Structure of Administration: Three concentric circles model.
• Most Radical Centralizer Emperor: Emperor Zara-Yaqob (r. 1434–1468).
• Chewa Regiments Role: Stationed as garrisons in the second concentric circle to maintain loyalty.

😂 የታሪክ ቀልድ: በወቅቱ በሦስተኛው ከበብ (Third Circle) ውስጥ የሚኖሩ መሪዎች ግብር አልከፍልም ማለት እኮ ከንጉሡ ሰራዊት ጋር "ላግኛችሁ ወይስ ትመጣላችሁ?" ብሎ ቀጠሮ የመያዝ ያህል አደገኛ ነበር! 😅


4.4.2. Military Organization

• Four Types of Regiments: Included 1) regular troops of the Emperor, 2) regular troops of military leaders, 3) specially mobilized territorial troops, and 4) irregular troops.
• The Chewa Regiments: The spearhead of traditional military units, organized on the basis of region of origin/identity and supplied by the peasantry. Other military terms included serawit, hara ('army'), and chefra ('body of troops'). Military titles included azmach, dejjazmach, ras, fitawrari, balambaras, azazh, and basha.
• Amde-Tsion's Military Units: Organized into three distinct categories:
1. Territorial forces: Named after recruitment provinces (e.g., Amhara, Shewa, Gojjam, Damot, Hadiya, Seqelt, Gondar, Harb Gwanda/Gafat, Nara).
2. Elite contingents: Prestigious names like Tekula ('Jackal'), Qeste neheb ('Arrow of a bee'), and Korem ('Cavalry').
3. Weapon-based units: Identified by equipment like Tsewareyane warmat ('Spear carriers'), Tsewareyane warmat abbiyan ('Large spear carriers'), and Tsewareyane asayeft ('Sword carriers').
• Innovations & Scale: Zara-Yaqob kept chewa as mobile striking forces. Foreign technologies were introduced from Mamluk Egypt and Europe. Shihab al-Din described Lebne-Dengel's army as "numerous as locusts" (16,000 cavalry and 200,000 infantry around 1529).

👉
1. የወታደራዊ ክፍሎች ዓይነቶች: ሠራዊቱ በ4 ይከፈላል፦ የንጉሡ መደበኛ፣ የጦር መሪዎች መደበኛ፣ ልዩ የክልል ጦር እና ያልተደራጁ (Irregular) ጦሮች። ዋናው ወታደራዊ ኃይል ጨዋ (Chewa) ይባላል።
2. የዓምደ-ጽዮን ልዩ የጦር ክፍሎች:
- በቦታ ስም: አምሐራ፣ ሸዋ፣ ጎጃም፣ ዳሞት ወዘተ።
- በልዩ መጠሪያ: ተኩላ (Tekula)፣ ቀስቴ ንህብ (Qeste neheb)፣ ኮረም (Korem)።
- በታጠቀው መሳሪያ: ፀዋርያነ ወርማት (የጦር ያዦች)፣ ፀዋርያነ አሳይፍት (የሰይፍ ያዦች)።
3. የሰራዊቱ ብዛት: ሽሃብ አድ-ዲን (Shihab al-Din) የአፄ ልብነ-ድንግልን ሰራዊት "እንደ አንበጣ መንጋ" ሲል ገልጾታል (16,000 ፈረሰኛና 200,000 እግረኛ በ1529 ዓ.ም)።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Core Military Regiments: Chewa.
• Examples of Elite Contingents: Tekula, Qeste neheb, Korem.
• Description of Lebne-Dengel's Army by Shihab al-Din: "As numerous as locusts".

😂 የታሪክ ቀልድ: የዓምደ-ጽዮን የጦር ክፍል ስም "ቀስቴ ንህብ" (Arrow of a bee) መጠራቱ፤ የጠላት ጦር ገና ሳይዋጋ በስሙ ብቻ ንብ እንደወጋው አድርጎ የማስፈራራት ስትራቴጂ ሳይሆን አይቀርም! 🐝⚔️


4.4.3. Temporal Administrative and Military Decline

• Factors for Decline (Late 15th Century):
1. Internal Political Rift: Began at the end of Zara-Yaqob's reign; law and order broke down, monarchy weakened, and disgruntled lords defected to Muslim forces.
2. Failure of National Integration: Cultural assimilation failed despite vast conquests. Zara-Yaqob attempted to superimpose religious nationalism, which backfired. Successors were young, inexperienced monarchs with ambitious royal councillors, reducing central revenue flow.

👉
1. የውድቀት መንስኤዎች: በ15ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን መጨረሻ የመንግሥቱ ኃይል በሁለት ምክንያቶች ተዳከመ፦ የውስጥ የፖለቲካ ክፍፍል (ከአፄ ዘርዐ ያዕቆብ ዘመን በኋላ) እና ብሔራዊ መዋሃድ (National Integration) አለመኖሩ።
2. የሃይማኖት ብሔረተኝነት ውድቀት: አፄ ዘርዐ ያዕቆብ ሃይማኖትን መሠረት ያደረገ አንድነት ለመፍጠር የሄዱበት መንገድ አልተሳካም፤ ተከታዮቻቸውም ወጣትና ልምድ የሌላቸው በመሆናቸው ገቢውና ማዕከላዊ ኃይሉ ቀነሰ።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Main Causes of Decline: Internal political rifts and failure of cultural/national integration.


4.5. Economic Bases of the Kingdom

• Primary Sources of Revenue: Land, labor, and trade routes. Land supported farming, animal husbandry, and mineral mining (copper, iron, gold, silver).
• Land Grants & Fiefs: Land was allocated as fiefs to followers in exchange for military services.
• Tributes & Trade Taxes: Significant wealth came from tributes imposed on dependent peripheries (failure to pay was treason punished by execution/arrest). Controlling eastern trade routes allowed monarchs to levy import/export taxes on traded goods and organize state-led trade caravans.

👉
1. የኢኮኖሚ ምንጮች: የመንግሥቱ ዋና ኢኮኖሚ መሬት፣ ጉልበት እና የንግድ መስመሮች ነበሩ። መሬት ለእርሻ፣ ለእንስሳት እርባታና ለወርቅ/ብረት ማዕድን ማውጫ ያገለግል ነበር።
2. ጉልትና ግብር: መሬት ለወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ምትክ በጉልት (Fiefs) መልክ ይሰጥ ነበር። በተጨማሪም ከገባሪ አካባቢዎች የሚሰብሰበው ግብር እና በንግድ መስመሮች ላይ የሚጣለው የወጪ/ገቢ ንግድ ታክስ ዋናው ገቢ ነበር።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Three Pillar Economic Bases: Land, labor, and trade routes.
• Consequence of Tribute Refusal: Viewed as treason leading to disgrace, arrest, or execution.


4.6. Cooperation, Competition and Conflict between Christian and Muslim Rival Powers

• Major Muslim Principalities: Shewa, Ifat, Fatagar, Dawaro, Hadiya, Bale, and Adal.
• Distinction between Ifat and Adal: Adal was originally a small state south of Ifat, conquered by Walasma ruler of Ifat in 1288. Later in 1415, when King Yishaq captured Zeila and killed Sultan Sadaddin Abu l-Barakat Muhammad b. Ahmad, the Walasma family fled to Yemen. Upon return, they shifted their capital to Dakar (east of Harar) and became "Sultans of Adal", absorbing Ifat.
• Nature of Relations: Swung between peaceful cooperation (tributary system, trade route security) and armed conflict driven by economic/political hegemony.
• Key Conflicts & Battles:
- Amde-Tsion (1332): Crushed alliance of Ifat's Sultan Sabreddin, Dawaro's Haydara, and Hadiya's Amano.
- Battle of Yeguba (1445): Emperor Zara-Yaqob defeated and killed Adal king Ahmed Badlay.
- 1517 Conflict: Emir Mahfuz of Adal advanced against Emperor Lebne-Dengel but failed and was killed in July 1517.
• Not Purely Religious: Religion was used for mobilization (crusading/jihadist fervor), but primary causes were trade and political hegemony.

👉
1. በኢፋት (Ifat) እና አዳል (Adal) መካከል ያለው ልዩነት: አዳል በስተደቡብ ያለች አነስተኛ ግዛት ነበረች። በ1415 ንጉሥ ይስሐቅ ዘይላን ተቆጣጥሮ ሱልጣን ሰዓደዲንን ሲገድል የወላስማ ቤተሰቦች ወደ የመን ተሰደዱ። ሲመለሱ መዲናቸውን ወደ ደካር (Dakar) በመቀየር የ"አዳል ሱልጣኔት" ብለው ተደራጁ።
2. ዋና ዋና ውጊያዎች:
- የ1332 ዓ.ም ውጊያ: አፄ ዓምደ-ጽዮን የኢፋቱን ሳብረዲን፣ የዳዋሮውን ሃይደራ እና የሀዲያውን አማኖ ጥረት ደመሰሱ።
- የየጉባ ውጊያ (Battle of Yeguba - 1445): አፄ ዘርዐ ያዕቆብ የአዳልን ንጉሥ አሕመድ ባድላይን ገደሉ።
- የ1517 ዓ.ም ውጊያ: ኤሚር ማህፉዝ በአፄ ልብነ-ድንግል ተሸንፎ ተገደለ።
3. የግጭቱ መንስኤ: ግጭቱ የሃይማኖት ቢመስልም ዋናው ምክንያት የንግድ መስመሮችን እና የበላይነትን መቆጣጠር (Economic & Political Hegemony) ነበር።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Battle of Yeguba (1445): Emperor Zara-Yaqob defeated Ahmed Badlay of Adal.
